tool_signatures.name: add_iscsi_target
tool_signatures.description: [WRITE] Add an iSCSI send (dynamic discovery) target to an ESXi host's software iSCSI adapter, then automatically rescan all HBAs and VMFS volumes to discover new LUNs.

host_name.description: ESXi host name as shown in vCenter inventory.

address.description: iSCSI portal IP address (IPv4/IPv6 literal; hostnames are rejected with a validation error).

confirm.description: False (default) returns the blast radius and changes nothing. True applies it.

dry_run.description: Deprecated alias for confirm; removed in the next minor release. dry_run=False acts, dry_run=True previews.

target.description: Optional vCenter/ESXi target name from config.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: iSCSI portal IP address (IPv4/IPv6 literal; hostnames are rejected with a validation error).

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: False (default) returns the blast radius and changes nothing. True applies it.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Deprecated alias for confirm; removed in the next minor release. dry_run=False acts, dry_run=True previews.

parameters.name: host_name
parameters.description: ESXi host name as shown in vCenter inventory.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: iSCSI TCP port, 1-65535 (default 3260).

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Optional vCenter/ESXi target name from config.

tool_signatures.name: list_cached_images
tool_signatures.description: [READ] List deployable images (OVA/OVF/ISO/VMDK) from the local cache registry — instant, no vCenter connection or datastore I/O.

datastore.description: Filter by exact datastore name. Omit for all datastores.

target.description: Only rows scanned from this vCenter/ESXi target (a name from config, as scan_datastore_images takes; an unknown name is refused with the configured ones). Rows cached before rows recorded their target appear only when this is omitted. Omit for every target.
